project.subtitle: Manage the projects you added and their worktrees

override.title: Project overrides
override.hint: Only affects new terminal sessions in this project; existing sessions keep their first launch parameters.
override.agentsHint: Leave empty to inherit global settings; command is the program, args go on the right.

userWorkspace.title: User workspace
userWorkspace.name: Display name
userWorkspace.hint: A non-git workspace pointing at your home directory; the display name is local only.

general.confirmClose: Confirm before closing a running terminal
general.confirmCloseHint: Ask before closing a terminal tab whose command is still running.
general.subtitle: Default shell, startup behavior, language and logs.
general.shellHint: Leave empty to auto-detect Git Bash / PowerShell; paths may contain spaces.
general.startupHint: Whether to restore the previous workspace on launch.
general.languageHint: MVP ships Simplified Chinese; empty follows the system.

agents.subtitle: Configure each agent launch command, arguments and icon color. Plain terminals remain available.
agents.name: Name
agents.hint: Runs in the worktree directory. Put the executable in Command and flags in Arguments.

integration.title: Integrations
integration.subtitle: Nothing is written until you review the diff and confirm. Restart the agent after enabling.
integration.shimMissing: ageminal-notify.exe is not yet copied to its stable path; enabling may fail.
integration.previewHint: These files will be written after confirmation. Existing files are backed up as .ageminal-backup-[timestamp] first. No other config keys or PATH are touched.
integration.applied: {name} integration enabled. Restart the agent to make it effective.
integration.appliedWithBackups:
{name} integration enabled.
Backups:
{paths}
Restart the agent to make it effective.

appearance.subtitle: Theme is fixed to One Dark Pro Glass; terminals stay opaque.
appearance.themeHint: MVP is dark One Dark Pro Glass only; light / system themes are deferred.
appearance.acrylicHint: Requires an app restart; terminals remain opaque.

shortcuts.subtitle: Read-only in the MVP; customization is deferred.
shortcuts.readOnly: Only these management keys are intercepted while the terminal is focused.

about.subtitle: Version, third-party licenses and dependency list.
about.fontDerivation: Ageminal Mono is derived from Maple Mono NF CN v7.9 and renamed; font assets are not distributed in this repository yet.
about.dependencyHint: Major direct dependencies are listed here; the full audit runs in scripts/check-licenses.mjs.
about.channel: Update channel: Stable (manual overwrite install only; no auto-updater)
about.updateHint: Download a newer installer and overwrite-install. A running daemon and its sessions are not stopped by the uninstall hook; reopen the app to reattach.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics & logs
diagnostics.hint: Review file sizes before export; redacted by default, no terminal history or conversations.
diagnostics.includeRawPaths: Include raw paths (tokens are still removed)
diagnostics.redaction: By default USERPROFILE becomes [user], project paths become [project-N], and daemon tokens are removed.
